objects.description: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) has queried the Registry on compromised systems, `reg query hklm\software\`, for information on installed software including PuTTY.(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory Volt Typhoon June 2023)(Citation: CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024)
objects.description_fa: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) از رجیستری سیستم‌های در معرض خطر، «reg query hklm\software»، برای اطلاعات در مورد نرم‌افزار نصب‌شده از جمله PuTTY سؤال کرده است.(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory Volt Typhoon June 2023)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_1]] (Citation: CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024)
